items.excerpt: Germany’s latest economic indicators show mixed signals across key sectors. The composite Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) contracted slightly to 52.8 from 53.8, suggesting a modest slowdown in overall economic activity. Manufacturing firms bucked the trend with a PMI increase to 54.2 from 53.9, indicating steady growth in the sector. Conversely, the services sector contracted, with its PMI falling to 51.7 from 52.9, pointing to a potential cooling in service-related activity.
